full_judgment:
Naima Haider J: In this application under Article 102 of the Constitution, Rule was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the inclusion of the petitioner No. 1 company's 123 decimals of land situated at Mouza-Zamur and Mouza-Zamur Muchipara having RS Khatian Nos. 295, 110, 114, 107 and RS Dag Nos. 304, 49, 50 & 51 under Police Station-Savar, District-Dhaka as per the decision of the respondent No. 2 (i.e. the Divisional Commissioner, Dhaka Division) dated 1-12-2011 in LA Case No. 2/2011-2012 shall not be declared to have been made and issued without lawful authority and is of no legal effect and why inclusion of the petitioner No. 1 company's said land shall not be declared arbitrary, malafide and discriminatory and to be violative of the fundamental rights guaranteed to the petitioners under Articles 27, 31, 40 and 42 of the Constitution and further as to why the respondents shall not be directed to exclude the said land of the petitioner company from the proceeding of LA case No. 2/2011-2012. 

 5. The petitioners in this Writ Petition have challenged the propriety and legality for inclusion/acquisition of the petitioner company's 123 decimals of land situated at Mouza-Zamur and Mouza-Zamur Muchipara comprising RS Khatian Nos. 295, 110, 114, 107 and R.S. Dag Nos. 304, 49, 50 & 51 under Police Station-Savar, District-Dhaka in LA Case No. 2/2011-2012, initiated by the respondent Nos. 3 under the provisions of the Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Property Ordinance, 1982. 

 10. Although due to the serious hard work and integrity, the petitioner company has achieved very good reputation in the World Market, yet the petitioner company did not have any land of its own for construction of buildings for garments industry and, as such, for the purpose of establishing its own factory/ buildings, the petitioner company purchased 123 decimals of land situated at Mouza-Zamur and Mouza-Zamur Muchipara comprising RS Khatian Nos. 295, 110, 114, 107 and R.S. Dag Nos. 304, 49, 50, & 51 under Police Station-Savar, District-Dhaka, vide registered Deed of Sale No. 9966 dated 19-3-2009, (area 44 decimals), Deed of Sale No. 38429 dated 15-10-2009, (area 24 decimals), Deed of Sale No. 27091 dated 22-7-2009, (area 43 decimals) and Deed of Sale No. 2564 dated 3-2-2011, (area 12 decimals of land). The lands were duly mutated in the name of the petitioner company. The petitioner company has also paid upto date land development tax. 

 52. The respondents are also directed to exclude 123 decimals of land of the petitioner company situated at Mouza-Zamur and Mouza-Zaxnur Muchipara comprising RS Khatian Nos. 295, 110, 114, 107 and RS Dag Nos. 304, 49, 50 & 51 under Police Station-Savar, District-Dhaka from the proceeding of LA Case No. 2/2011-2012.
